star_curve_monthly.note: New stars per calendar month, measured from the stargazer timestamps. The series is cumulative and has never fallen: no star has ever been unstarred in a way the timeline shows.

fork_state.note: The repository counter is 117; the network list returns 122. All of them are passive clones: every one has 0 stars and 0 forks of its own, 115 are owned by a user account and 7 by an organization.

traffic.referrers_note: The traffic API returned an empty referrer list for this window, so no referrer split is recorded. The W46 measurement attributed 81 of the 262 unique visitors to aocr.org, a radiology college's site; the drop of 77 unique visitors is that single referrer leaving, not a fall in arrival.
